summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases under the second tranche of its 2026 buyback programme, which runs from May 19 to no later than July 20, 2026. Between June 8-12, 2026, it bought 414,792 shares at an average price of NOK 353.25, for a total of ~NOK 147 million. Accumulated under the tranche, 1,469,068 shares have been bought at an average of NOK 353.76. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 66.5 million own shares (2.60% of capital, including shares under a savings programme). No board or advisor named. The buyback is routine capital return, not a tender offer. Watch for volume and price impact.
